content: Deflated Sharpe Ratio / Probability of Backtest Overfitting (Bailey & Lopez de Prado) corrects for selection bias under multiple testing and non-normal returns. Core insight: the probability of selecting an overfit strategy grows rapidly with the number of trials, and the single most-missing datum in published backtests is the NUMBER OF TRIALS ATTEMPTED. Search found only academic sources - no retail or AI-first platform surfaces DSR/PBO as a first-class user-facing feature. This is genuine open space.
